snippet.title: Kao: Resurgence of the Volcano - Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Kao: Resurgence of the Volcano is now available!

This is a fanmade expansion mod for Kao: Mystery of the Volcano. This mod aims to complete the original game and bring it closer to fulfilling its untapped potential.
 
- Explore an undiscovered island in a quest to find the elusive Mist Artifact
- Master a new tool - the grappler - to help you navigate environments
- Save the villagers from invading enemies in a new surfing minigame
- Learn new abilities by collecting Star Runes scattered across the world
- Help reunite a pelican family in a new side quest
- Enjoy enhanced visuals across the whole game

Download link: https://chaos-flask.itch.io/kao-the-kangaroo-resurgence-of-the-volcano
Contact us at: chaosflask@gmail.com
